question: How long does it take to sell a house in Virginia Beach, VA?
answer: The median home that sold in Virginia Beach, VA was on the market 15 days before going under contract, from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026. 49% sold in 14 days or less, and 12% took more than 60 days. Closing typically takes additional time after the contract.
answer_short: Median 15 days on market; 49% sold within 14 days.
description: Virginia Beach VA homes took a median of 15 days to sell, per 12,010 closed REIN MLS sales. See how pace varies by price and what sellers can do.
body:
Days on market counts the days from listing to going under contract. For Virginia Beach, the median was 15 days across 12,010 closed sales (November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026); the middle half of homes took between 4 and 37 days. That does not include the weeks it usually takes to close after a contract is signed.

Why Some Homes Sell Faster

Pricing is the biggest lever: homes priced to recent comparable sales draw the most early attention. Condition, photography and the season matter too. Homes that sit past the first few weeks often need a price or presentation change. Virginia Beach sellers can see how fast individual neighborhoods move in the neighborhood guides below.

Typical Negotiation Room

The median Virginia Beach home sold at 100.0% of its list price. 36% sold above list price and 7% sold at least 5% below it, so outcomes varied widely.
faqs: Do homes in Virginia Beach sell above asking price?
36% of Virginia Beach homes sold for more than their list price and 7% sold at least 5% below it, per REIN MLS closed sales (November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026).
